breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the varying bending moment M(x) = P*(L-x) along the span, rather than the incorrect constant peak value M = P*L. It instructs to integrate M(x)^2/(2EI) with this position-dependent moment and then differentiate with respect to P, which matches the ground truth approach.
